lines.t: [fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive slaps]
[Verse 1]
When I was buried in my shame
He knew my name
He knew my pain
I tried to hide behind my scars
But You came close and found my heart
And all the pieces I could not repair
You held them gently like You care
[Chorus]
Your love came after me
When I had nothing left to bring
You met me in the dark and held me like a father holds his child
Your love came after me and I can't explain the way You see
Every broken part of me, You loved me first and You still do
[vocal ad-libs: oh, oh]
[Verse 2]
When I was tired of running far
You never changed, You never lost heart
You stayed with me through every fall
When I was weak You carried all
And all the tears I tried to hide
You saw them fall and stayed beside me
(Oh)
[Chorus]
Your love came after me
When I had nothing left to bring
You met me in the dark and held me like a father holds his child
Your love came after me and I can't explain the way You see
Every broken part of me, You loved me first and You still do
[Bridge]
I was wandering, You were patient
I was hurting, You were kind
I was empty, You were faithful
You never left me behind
And now I know deep in my soul
There is nowhere I can go
That Your love won't find me there
That Your love won't find me there
That Your love won't find me there
[Chorus]
Your love came after me
When I had nothing left to bring
You met me in the dark and held me like a father holds his child
Your love came after me and I can't explain the way You see
Every broken part of me, You loved me first and You still do
[vocal ad-libs: oh, oh]
[Outro]
[instruments fade to acoustic guitar and soft synth pad]
[final chord rings out]
